Feature.Description: Provides a live camera feed from an IP camera (HTTP/RTSP) or USB webcam. The stream can be started with a source URL or device index and frames are captured in a background thread. Clients retrieve individual JPEG frames via GetLatestFrame, or the web UI can display a continuous MJPEG stream via the Flask proxy endpoint.

Command.Description: Begin capturing frames from a camera source. The Source parameter accepts an HTTP/RTSP URL for IP cameras (e.g. "http://192.168.1.100/mjpg/video.mjpg") or a device index string for USB webcams (e.g. "0" for the first camera).

Parameter.Description: Camera source: an HTTP/RTSP URL for IP cameras, or a device index (e.g. "0", "1") for USB webcams.

Command.Description: Stop the camera capture and release the device.
Return the most recently captured JPEG frame from the camera. The stream must be started first via StartStream.

Response.Description: The latest camera frame as JPEG binary data.

Property.Description: Whether the camera capture is currently active.

DefinedExecutionError.Description: The specified camera source could not be opened. Check the URL or device index and ensure the camera is connected and accessible.
An error occurred during camera streaming, such as a failed frame capture or a disconnected camera.
